section.title: org.osgi.service.remoteserviceadmin.namespace
section.para: Bundles should not need to import this package at runtime since all the types in this package just contain constants for capability and requirement namespaces specified by the OSGi Working Group.

listitem.para: DiscoveryNamespace - Remote Services Discovery Provider Capability and Requirement Namespace.
DistributionNamespace - Remote Services Distribution Provider Capability and Requirement Namespace.
TopologyNamespace - Remote Services Topology Manager Capability and Requirement Namespace.

section.title: public final class DiscoveryNamespace extends Namespace
section.para: Remote Services Discovery Provider Capability and Requirement Namespace.
This class defines the names for the attributes and directives for this namespace.

section.title: public static final String CAPABILITY_PROTOCOLS_ATTRIBUTE = "protocols"
section.para: The capability attribute used to specify the discovery protocols supported by this discovery provider. The value of this attribute must be of type {@code String} or {@code List<String>}.

section.title: public static final String DISCOVERY_NAMESPACE = "osgi.remoteserviceadmin.discovery"
section.para: Namespace name for Remote Services discovery provider capabilities and requirements.

section.title: public final class DistributionNamespace extends Namespace
section.para: Remote Services Distribution Provider Capability and Requirement Namespace.
This class defines the names for the attributes and directives for this namespace.

section.title: public static final String CAPABILITY_CONFIGS_ATTRIBUTE = "configs"
section.para: The capability attribute used to specify the config types supported by this distribution provider. The value of this attribute must be of type {@code String} or {@code List<String>}.

section.title: public static final String DISTRIBUTION_NAMESPACE = "osgi.remoteserviceadmin.distribution"
section.para: Namespace name for Remote Services distribution provider capabilities and requirements.

section.title: public final class TopologyNamespace extends Namespace
section.para: Remote Services Topology Manager Capability and Requirement Namespace.
This class defines the names for the attributes and directives for this namespace.

section.title: public static final String CAPABILITY_POLICY_ATTRIBUTE = "policy"
section.para: The capability attribute used to specify the policy or policies supported by this topology manager. The value of this attribute must be of type {@code String} or {@code List<String>}. Policy names are typically implementation specific, however the Remote Services Specification defines the promiscuous and fail-over policies for common use cases.

section.title: public static final String FAIL_OVER_POLICY = "fail-over"
section.para: The attribute value for Topology managers with a fail-over policy

section.title: public static final String PROMISCUOUS_POLICY = "promiscuous"
section.para: The attribute value for Topology managers with a promiscuous policy

section.title: public static final String TOPOLOGY_NAMESPACE = "osgi.remoteserviceadmin.topology"
section.para: Namespace name for Remote Services topology manager capabilities and requirements.
